scope: Same-GPU complete routed W8A16 FC1/activation + FC2/ordered-combine interval. Original best 16 Frost tactics versus expanded 40; no serving, router-network, shared-expert, EP, preparation or host timing. Both sides use identical checkpoint payloads, scales, routes and typed rounding.
timer: CUPTI first-to-last GPU activity span, 4-round ABBA validation. Separate warm amortized CUDA-event controls retained; cold rows are not cold event-chain measurements.
qualification: 370 passed/4 skipped full integration, 36 mixed-output/odd-token graph cases, 32 architecture/token/dtype admission cases on SM120. T=2 excluded after 7-8% cold loss; SM90/100/103 groups not advertised after negative measurements.
